name: novaforge-game-engine
description: Zero-dependency 2D/3D game engine and arcade studio with 8 complete playable games, in-browser studio tools, physics, audio synthesis, and automated tests.

scripts.count-loc: python -c "import os; print(sum(len(open(os.path.join(r, f), encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore').readlines()) for r, d, fs in os.walk('.') if not any(x in r for x in ('.git', '__pycache__')) for f in fs if f.endswith(('.js', '.css', '.html', '.json', '.md', '.py'))))"

author: NovaForge Engineering Team
